name: Italian Sausage, Peppers and Onions (No-Rice Skillet)
ingredients_verbatim: 9 oz mixed color bell pepper, sliced into strips (about 2 large peppers)
1 tbsp olive oil (or more to taste)
why: Sausage-forward no-rice skillet: Italian sausage + bell peppers + onions bound with a splash of marinara. Structurally low-carb (meat + non-starchy veg, no starch base). Published nutrition 420 cal / 8g carb / 23.5g protein per serving clears the band. Distinct from catalog's rice-based turkey-sausage-and-peppers dish. Scales cleanly to 14 as a skillet or sheet-pan bake.
